# ISuperstateToken

## ISuperstateToken
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/superstate/ISuperstateToken.sol)

**Title:**
Superstate Token Interface

Combined interface for Superstate fund tokens (e.g. USTB, USCC), covering subscriptions,
stablecoin configuration, and oracle access.


### Functions
#### subscribe

Subscribes to mint Superstate Fund Tokens to a designated address.

The caller MUST be on the Superstate on-chain Allowlist, and the `to` address must be allowlisted.


```solidity
function subscribe(address to, uint256 inAmount, address stablecoin) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`to`|`address`|The address to receive the minted fund tokens.|
|`inAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of stablecoin to subscribe.|
|`stablecoin`|`address`|The address of the stablecoin to use.|


#### subscribe

Subscribes to mint Superstate Fund Tokens to the caller.

The caller MUST be on the Superstate on-chain Allowlist.


```solidity
function subscribe(uint256 inAmount, address stablecoin) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`inAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of stablecoin to subscribe.|
|`stablecoin`|`address`|The address of the stablecoin to use.|


#### supportedStablecoins

Returns the supported stablecoin configuration for a given stablecoin address.


```solidity
function supportedStablecoins(address stablecoin) external view returns (SupportedStablecoin memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`stablecoin`|`address`|The stablecoin address to query.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`SupportedStablecoin`|The SupportedStablecoin struct containing the sweep destination and fee.|


#### offchainRedeem

Initiates an off-chain redemption of Superstate Fund Tokens.

Burns the caller's fund tokens and triggers off-chain USDC settlement (T+1/T+2).


```solidity
function offchainRedeem(uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of fund tokens to redeem.|


#### superstateOracle

Returns the oracle configured for this Superstate token.

Used during deployment of SuperstateSubscribeArk to validate that the passed
oracle address matches the one the token contract itself is configured with.


```solidity
function superstateOracle() external returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the configured oracle.|




## SupportedStablecoin
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/superstate/ISuperstateToken.sol)

Configuration for a stablecoin accepted for subscriptions


```solidity
struct SupportedStablecoin {
address sweepDestination;
uint96 fee;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sweepDestination`|`address`|The address that received subscribed stablecoins are swept to|
|`fee`|`uint96`|The subscription fee charged for this stablecoin|
